  • Constructor Details

    • hwloc_topology_support

      public hwloc_topology_support(ByteBuffer container)
      Creates a hwloc_topology_support instance at the current position of the specified ByteBuffer container. Changes to the buffer's content will be visible to the struct instance and vice versa.

      The created instance holds a strong reference to the container object.
